continuity_scope: Netflix's live-action The Witcher television continuity only, bounded to Season 1 Episode 1, "The End’s Beginning" (2019), its official Netflix synopsis/credits context, and primary episode evidence. Sapkowski's books, CD PROJEKT games, animation, Blood Origin, later episodes/seasons, and all recast-continuity assumptions are excluded.
work_or_witnesses: The Witcher, S1 E1: The End’s Beginning, official Netflix episode listing and primary episode witness
Netflix The Witcher programme page, Season 1 episode guide
Netflix 2018 casting announcement and The Witcher: A Look Inside the Episodes, Episode 1
coverage_rule: Include the named dramatic figures in the two opening E1 story groups supported by official synopsis/credits/primary witness: Geralt, Renfri, and Stregobor at Blaviken; Ciri, Queen Calanthe, Eist, and Mousesack at Cintra. Peoples/species, witcher vocation/transformation, magic, monsters, places, institutions, artifacts, and the opening's separate story strands remain terms or omissions.
omissions: Named but secondary E1 figures, unnamed townspeople/soldiers/monsters, and any character introduced after E1 are excluded by the bounded opening-group rule.
Books, games, animation, Blood Origin, later episodes/seasons, and recast continuity are separate continuities and are not merged.

The episode contains combat, child/youth peril, political violence, and sexual-content context. This pass neither reproduces graphic details nor draws conclusions about consent, sexuality, infertility, disability/body difference, race/ethnicity, gender, or later outcomes.
No later title, magical ability, destiny relationship, lineage, or adaptation difference is inferred unless explicitly available in the selected E1 official material.
uncertainties: Netflix's E1 listing supplies only a compact two-strand synopsis; the record does not resolve their full chronology, causal linkage, or later convergence.

The 2018 Netflix casting announcement identifies Ciri, Calanthe, Eist, Mousesack, Renfri, and Geralt, while the primary episode supplies their E1 presence. It is used for cast/role names, not later characterization.
Witcher, mage, Cintra, Nilfgaard, and Dothraki-like real-world comparisons are not made: these are fictional source terms in a distinct television adaptation.
evidence_basis: Official Netflix episode/programme pages, Netflix's casting announcement, and the primary E1 witness only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, book/game source, unofficial transcript, or later-continuity source is used.
